device.description: 16-bit 1 MSPS single-ended SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial interface and daisy-chain
device.note: ads8860.pdf (SBAS569B) p.4 pin functions, p.7 power-supply requirements, p.8 timing requirements (3-wire), p.9 Figure 1, p.21 transfer function (straight binary), p.21-23 3-wire CS mode

pages: p.4 (pins), p.7 (supply ranges), p.8-9 (3-wire timing, Figure 1), p.21 (transfer function), p.21-23 (CS modes), p.27 (daisy-chain)
notModeled: analog input and reference (the 0 V code is 0000h)
mode selection by the DIN level at the CONVST rising edge: only 3-wire CS mode without a busy indicator (DIN high, CONVST as CS) is modeled; DIN is not read
4-wire CS mode (DIN as CS), busy indicator bit (CONVST or DIN held low at the end of conversion), daisy-chain mode (DIN as chain input)
DOUT driven while CONVST is low during a conversion (modeled: the frame shows the last result)
conversion time varies 500-710 ns (modeled: tconv-max 710 ns); acquisition time and power-down between conversions
DVDD 1.65-2.7 V allows SCLK < 40 MHz only; 66.6 MHz SCLK needs DVDD >= 2.7 V
variants: ADS8860 only (the 16-bit 1 MSPS single-ended member of the ADS886x family; siblings have their own datasheets).
